description: Shared Renovate posture for folklorevault repos. Consume with: { "extends": ["local>folklorevault/renovate-config"] }

packageRules.description: Pin ESLint to the v9 maintenance line until eslint-config-next's bundled plugins (eslint-plugin-react, typescript-eslint) support ESLint 10's breaking context/scope-manager API changes. No-op in repos without ESLint.

Pin @babel/core to the v7 maintenance line. Transitive dep already patched at 7.29.6+ via a pnpm-workspace override; widening past v8 gives no security benefit and risks an unvalidated major. Lift only as a deliberate, tested babel 8 upgrade. No-op in repos without Babel.

Pin undici to the v7 maintenance line. Transitive Sanity-tooling dep already patched at 7.28.0+ via a pnpm-workspace override; the pin exists only to escape a vuln, not to track latest. Lift only as a deliberate, tested undici 8 upgrade. No-op in repos without undici.

Pin @portabletext/react to the v6 line. v7 moved to a client-only React context that leaks React.createContext into the Next RSC/server build ('createContext is not a function' collecting page data). Lift only as a deliberate upgrade once PortableText usage sits behind a 'use client' boundary. No-op in repos without it.

Cap the pnpm packageManager field to the v10 line so Renovate never auto-migrates a repo from pnpm 10 to 11. Renovate never downgrades, so repos already pinned to pnpm 11 are untouched — moving a site onto 11 is a deliberate packageManager + mise edit in that repo. Lockfile regeneration follows each repo's own packageManager pin: there is deliberately NO global constraints.pnpm here, because a global pnpm constraint overrides the per-repo packageManager field and forced pnpm-11 repos to regenerate under pnpm 10, which resolved a duplicate React into the Next RSC server bundle and broke builds with 'createContext is not a function'.

Auto-merge low-risk updates once CI passes. Majors are still opened as PRs for manual review. Combined with the weekly schedule, routine minor/patch bumps land themselves without ever needing a click.
Group all Sanity-ecosystem MAJOR updates into a single PR so the suite moves together instead of one PR per package. Non-major Sanity updates still flow through group:allNonMajor.
Group all ESLint-ecosystem MAJOR updates into a single PR. Non-major ESLint updates still flow through group:allNonMajor.
